name: U2Net_QBGF2_retrain_v1
epoch_source: U2Net original paper section4.1; official train.py default500 is not used
loss: L1 normalized final raw network output, no training clipping
validation: all validation samples every epoch; no shuffle/drop; raw untiled 64px network output
selection: minimum validation MSE, epoch0 included, earliest tie
provided_lms: not used by U2Net; original input preserved
differences_from_official_code: GF2 normalized by1023 rather than upstream hardcoded2047
micro4 accumulation to effective16 for T4 memory
validation every epoch, full split, MSE-best instead of periodic weights
seed42, sampler RNG separated, full resume metadata
extra_methods: none: no EMA, mixed-scale pairs, spectral loss, projection, or band calibration on U2Net
metric_note: common rr_metrics PSNR uses2047 for every sensor. Preserve PSNR_repo_peak2047 and also report GF2 PSNR_sensor_peak1023 with baseline adjusted by the same constant. Never mix their absolute values.
